title: Access NUST consolidated research directory
scope: Supplied research only; no new web research or application changes.
rules: All canonical coordinates are null; candidate coordinates are isolated in uncertainCoordinates.
publicMapEligible is false for every record and coordinate pending review.
Gate 16 and reception polygon are explicitly excluded, not renamed as verified facilities.
Guide omission does not establish nonexistence.
Hostel groups are individual entries linked to the aggregate, not aliases of one hostel.
Potentially related buildings/services are not merged without identity evidence.
Guide creation date is file metadata, not publication date.
Evidence access and dates are preserved as supplied, not certified as independently verified.
